finding.before: The exact Fraction reader refused irrational radicals, but the variance consumer silently discarded those claims or unreadable links in an equality chain. It could report no finding and return RC0 for V=4, sigma=sqrt(3).
finding.after: Every recognized variance/sigma claim is preserved. Unreadable chain segments generate UNPARSED_MATHEMATICAL_CLAIM, severity CERTIFICATION_BLOCKER. A dependent sigma cannot reuse an earlier variance instead of the nearest unreadable one. The CLI fails on any such blocker even with no product P0. No mathematical error is inferred solely from unreadability.

classification: NON_VERIFIED is distinct from FALSE; both a correct and an incorrect unsupported irrational radical remain unverified with this intentionally rational-only reader.
